How to add an entry

  1. Copy template.html to entries/YYYY-MM-DD_short-title.html
  2. Fill in every section, including the <meta name="finding"> one-liner in the page <head>
  3. Drop images into assets/images/ and reference them as ../assets/images/filename.png
  4. Add the new filename to entries/manifest.json — the table and counts below update automatically
